clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Covers materials, dimension and methods of testing of pitch impregnated fibre pipes and fittings in diametrs ranging from 50 to 200 mm for drainage purposes below and above ground level. 1.2 The standard also covers perforated pipes of the same materials for sub-surface drainage.

clauses.title: Material
clauses.text: 2. Material

clauses.title: Pipes shall consist of
clauses.text: 2.1 Pipes shall consist of a preformed felted fibrous structure impregnated, with pitch, bitumen or other no less suitable compound.

clauses.title: Couplings and fittings shall be made of
clauses.text: 2.2 Couplings and fittings shall be made of : a) The same material as the pipe, or b) Polypropylene or other plastics material no less suitable, or c) Mineral fibre moulded from an inert aggregate mixed with an inorganic cement and impregnated with pitch, bitumen or other no less suitable material.

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: 3. General

clauses.title: Pipes
clauses.text: 3.1 Pipes

clauses.title: Length
clauses.text: 3.1.1 Length —Between 1.5 to 3.5 m with a tolerance of        25 mm. Variation from straight length maximum 1 in 100. Nominal Diameter of Pipes Nominal  Bore, mm Limites of internal 50 75 100 125 150 200 225 diameter, mm Minimum 50 75 100 125 150 200 225 Maximum 54 80 106 133 160 213 239

clauses.title: Pipes shall be made
clauses.text: 3.1.2 Pipes shall be made with ends suitable for the joint specified; square cut plain ends for snap joints and "C" coupling joints and with machined ends for taper coupling joints, soil "O" ring joints and for spigot and socket joints.

clauses.title: Perforated Pipes
clauses.text: 3.2 Perforated Pipes

clauses.title: Perforations shall be evenly
clauses.text: 3.2.1 Perforations shall be evenly spaced on rows parallel to the axis of the pipe.

clauses.title: The
clauses.text: 3.2.2 The  perforations shall be not less than 5 mm dia and not greater than 16 mm dia and the spacing in any row of perforations shall be 150  10 mm between adjacent holes in that row. For pipes up to 100 mm bore there shall be two rows of holes and for larger sizes there shall be four rows of holes. The centre lines of all perforations shall be contained within an arc of 160° and shall be cleanly drilled

clauses.title: Joints and Couplings
clauses.text: 4. Joints and Couplings a) Taper Cupling Joint b) Snap ring joint. c) Soil pipe "O" ring joints. d) Spigot and socket or rebated joints. e) Joints "C" coupling joints. Note— For details refer to 5 of the standard.

clauses.title: Fittings
clauses.text: 5. Fittings — Shall be either moulded to shape, or fabricated from pipe prior to impregnation. 5.2 Polypropylene fittings shall be black and consist of polypropylene polymer or copolymer composed principally of isotatic polypropylene together with suitably compounded stabilizers, lubricants and fillers. 5.3 Body Wall Thickness of Polypropylene Fittings— Nominal Bore, mm Minimum thickness 50 75 100 125 150 200 225 below ground work 3.5 3.5 4.0 5.2 5.2 7.0 7.0 Minimum thickness 2.7 2.7 2.7 3.8 3.8 3.8 3.8 above ground work ± ± Note—IS   5382 : 1985  Rubber sealing rings for gas gains, water mains and sewers (first revision). For detailed information, refer to  IS 11925 : 1986 Specification for pitch impregnated fibre pipes and fittings for drainage purposes.

clauses.title: Test
clauses.text: 6. Test

clauses.title: Pipes, Couplings and Fittings (except plastic
clauses.text: 6.1 Pipes, Couplings and Fittings (except plastic materials).

clauses.title: Chemical resistance
clauses.text: 6.1.1 Chemical resistance — Shall not show any evidence of softening or disintegration

clauses.title: Water Absorption
clauses.text: 6.1.2 Water Absorption — Gain in mass, expressed as a percentage of the original mass, shall not exceed 2 percent.

clauses.title: Resistance to Boiling Water
clauses.text: 6.1.3 Resistance to Boiling Water — Shall show no sign of disintegration or seperation into laminations.

clauses.title: Heat resistance
clauses.text: 6.1.4 Heat resistance — Shall show no appreciable distortion and no appreciable exudation of impregnant.

clauses.title: Resistance to flattening (pipe only)
clauses.text: 6.1.5 Resistance to flattening (pipe only)— Neither test piece shall show a decrease in diameter exceeding 3 percent at the point of application of the load.

clauses.title: Crushing strength test
clauses.text: 6.1.6 Crushing strength test — When tested for dry crushing wet crushing, resistance to kerosene, crushing after boiling water and crushing strength for coupling and fittings, the load at rupture shall not be less than that shown below: Nominal  Bore, mm 50 75 100 125 150 200 225 Pipes kg per m 1640 1640 1640 1940 1940 2380 2530 kg per test length 500 500 500 590 590 725 760 Couplings 122 143 169 195 195 304 317

clauses.title: Test of adhesive used in fabricated fittings
clauses.text: 6.1.7. Test of adhesive used in fabricated fittings  — Shall with stand, without fracture of the joint, on drop of 3.520.05 kg weight through its full distance of 1800mm.

clauses.title: Couplings and Fittings of Plastic Materials.
clauses.text: 6.2.   Couplings and Fittings of Plastic Materials.

clauses.title: Impact test
clauses.text: 6.2.1. Impact test— Shall show no evidence of open or closed cracking either on inside on outside surface when tested as per the prescribed procedures.

clauses.title: Tensile strength of weld line
clauses.text: 6.2.2. Tensile strength of weld line — The ring shall not fracture shilst being driven the specified distance.

clauses.title: Tests for Joints
clauses.text: 6.3. Tests for Joints— Shall  be capable of withstandig the specified internal hydraulic pressure . (kg per coupling)
